name: GrowthBook
summary: GrowthBook combines feature flags with experimentation and can be self-hosted. The cloud Starter plan is free for up to 3 users and the Pro plan costs $40 per seat per month. Feature flags, experiments and traffic are unlimited on both.

facts.text: Starter allows 3 users and 1 project, and Pro allows 30 users and 3 projects.
CDN requests include 1M a month on Starter and 2M on Pro, then cost $10 per extra million.
A percentage rollout samples users on a chosen attribute, so users with the same value get the same experience.
SDKs cover JavaScript, React, Vue, Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP, Java, C#, Go, Elixir and Rust, plus edge platforms.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Cloud, up to 3 users and 1 project. The page does not name a currency

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Cloud, up to 30 users and 3 projects. The page shows $ without naming a currency or a billing cycle other than per seat per month

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing for cloud or self-hosted

hiddenCosts: CDN bandwidth beyond the plan allowance costs $1 per extra GB.
Managed warehouse events beyond the allowance cost $30 per million.
